title: fix(charts): refuse a cartesian chart that declared no series binding at all (#4695)
body:
Fixes #4695
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

A `bar` / `horizontal-bar` / `line` / `area` / `combo` chart (and `column`, normalized to `bar`) handed data rows but **no series binding at all** (`series === undefined`) now refuses loudly instead of drawing axes, grid and legend around zero marks. This is maintainer ruling **A** on objectui#4695 (relayed in issue comment 5808476637).

- `hasNoPlottableSeries` (`packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`) now returns a discriminant, `'empty'` or `'undeclared'` or null, read on the RAW props in the outer `AdvancedChartImpl` wrapper, before `AdvancedChartImplInner`'s `series = []` default erases the difference. Its docstring (which used to record the `undefined` omission as deliberate) is rewritten.
- The objectui#4683 placeholder is reused: same `ChartRefusal` shell, same `role="status"`, same `data-chart-error="no-plottable-series"` code. No second placeholder. Only the sentence differs:
  - computed and empty (objectui#4683): "This chart cannot plot any series: no measure or group reached its `X` axis."
  - never declared (objectui#4695): "This chart cannot plot any series: none was declared to draw against its `X` axis."
- The console warning differs the same way: the undeclared arm names the row keys a series could bind and cites objectui#4695.
- The sentence is a literal, as the objectui#4683 one is. **No i18n pack key was added** (`packages/i18n/src/locales/*` untouched).

## The narrowed accept-set (for the contract review)

**Now refuses** (placeholder, no svg), only when `data` has at least one row and no category-axis refusal applies:
- `chartType` in `bar`, `horizontal-bar`, `line`, `area`, `combo`, `column`, or omitted (the renderer's `bar` default), with `series` absent. Through `ChartRenderer` that is an authored chart with no `series`, no `categories` and no y-axis `field` (a malformed `categories` or a retired `value` key included, since the normalizer yields no series for them).

**Still draws, unchanged:**
- any chart with a declared series (reverse control pinned: a `bar` with `series: [{ dataKey: 'est_hours' }]` draws 2 bars, no `data-chart-error`, no warning);
- `pie`, `donut`, `funnel`, `radar`, `scatter` (and the other `value`-fallback families) with no series. They fall back to the `value` column, pinned for the undefined arm too;
- any chart with zero rows (the chart's own empty state);
- the category-axis refusal (`missing-category-key`) still wins when both apply.

**Already refused before this PR, unchanged:** `series: []` on the same families (objectui#4683).

## Callers measured (PM hypothesis 4)

`ChartRenderer` is the only importer of `AdvancedChartImpl` (lazy). It forwards `spec.series ?? authored`, so `undefined` reaches the renderer only when the schema declared none of `series` / `categories` / y-axis fields. `ObjectChart` forwards `buildChartSeries` output (always an array) on the dataset path and `augmentedSeries` (or nothing) otherwise; `DashboardRenderer` always builds a `series` array. In every one of those, an `undefined` series on a cartesian family already drew **zero marks**, because the cartesian tail and the combo tail render `series.map(...)` and nothing else. So no caller drawing marks today can start refusing: the change turns silent empty frames into an explained refusal, and nothing else. Annotations (reference lines) with no series behave exactly as they already did under `series: []` since objectui#4683.

## Pins

- `AdvancedChartImpl.unprojectedSeriesDimension.test.tsx`: the pin `leaves a caller that computed NO series binding at all untouched` is **rewritten** (not deleted) to `refuses a caller that computed NO series binding at all, in its own sentence (objectui#4695)`. It asserts the placeholder, `role="status"`, no svg, one warning citing objectui#4695, and that its text differs from the computed-and-empty refusal's. A new `describe` block covers the undefined arm across the refusing families, the `value`-fallback families that keep drawing, the reverse control, and the no-rows case.
- `ChartRenderer.foreignDialectRetired-8650.test.tsx`: two cases pinned a bar with no series as "mounts and plots nothing" (malformed `categories`, retired `value`). That contradicts the ruling, so both now wait for the `no-plottable-series` refusal. The positive reading is kept: re-adding the retired read would plot, no refusal would arrive, and the `waitFor` goes red. **This file is outside the claimed file surface.** It is a test-only change forced by the ruling's "leave no pin contradicting it". None of the 23 open PRs touches it (their file lists were read).

## Verification (head `54f2e1d95`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-charts/`: 66 files / 599 tests passed at `54f2e1d95`.
- Earlier wide run at `d9dedb5cb` (plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report, plugin-view, plus every other chart-referencing test file across app-shell, console, schema-catalog, list, runner and others): 3414 passed, 2 failed. Those 2 are exactly the objectui#8650 pins above. After re-pointing them, both files pass (23/23).
- Ablation (committed state, fix arm replaced by a marker, marker count 1, anchor count 0; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hash matches HEAD): 4 red. They are the rewritten pin, the family loop, and both objectui#8650 cases. The other 19 in those files stay green.
- `plugin-charts` `type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' build`). `lint`: exit 0, 0 errors.
- `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- One `data-chart-error` code for both arms is deliberate. The ruling says to reuse the channel, and the two arms share the failure ("cannot plot a series"). A machine consumer that needs the arm reads the sentence or the warning. If a distinct code is wanted, that is a one-line follow-up.
- Changeset: `.changeset/4695-no-series-binding-refusal.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-charts: patch`.
